attributes.description: MIM V3 — major incident overview; one-CI investigation driven by the Incident / CI controls; the CI's related middleware, databases, servers and applications from the CMDB; application and service health (Application and Service controls) with dependencies and blast radius; related dashboards.

config.esql_query:
FROM metrics-apm.service_transaction.1m-*
| WHERE TO_LOWER(TO_STRING(service.environment)) IN ("prd1", "prd2", "prd", "prod", "production") AND @timestamp >= NOW() - 1 day
| STATS s = VALUES(service.name)
| EVAL service = CASE(s IS NULL, "(services on this CI)", MV_APPEND("(services on this CI)", s))
| MV_EXPAND service
| EVAL ord = CASE(service == "(services on this CI)", 0, 1)
| SORT ord ASC, service ASC
| KEEP service
config.title: Service

config.esql_query:
FROM servicenow-incidents-*
| WHERE priority IN (1, 2) AND ci.name IS NOT NULL AND opened_at >= NOW() - 31 days
| STATS cis = VALUES(ci.name)
| EVAL ci = MV_APPEND("(no CI selected)", cis)
| MV_EXPAND ci
| EVAL ord = CASE(ci == "(no CI selected)", 0, 1)
| SORT ord ASC, ci ASC
| KEEP ci
config.title: CI

config.esql_query:
FROM servicenow-incidents-*
| WHERE priority IN (1, 2) AND state_name NOT IN ("Resolved", "Closed", "Canceled", "Cancelled") AND number IS NOT NULL
| STATS cis = VALUES(TO_STRING(ci.name)) BY number
| EVAL inc = CONCAT(number, " · ", COALESCE(MV_FIRST(cis), "(no CI)"))
| STATS incs = VALUES(inc)
| EVAL incident = CASE(incs IS NULL, "(all incidents)", MV_APPEND("(all incidents)", incs))
| MV_EXPAND incident
| EVAL ord = CASE(incident == "(all incidents)", 0, 1)
| SORT ord ASC, incident DESC
| KEEP incident
config.title: Incident

config.esql_query:
FROM metrics-apm.service_transaction.1m-*
| WHERE TO_LOWER(TO_STRING(service.environment)) IN ("prd1", "prd2", "prd", "prod", "production") AND ci.name IS NOT NULL AND @timestamp >= NOW() - 1 day
| STATS apps = VALUES(TO_STRING(ci.name))
| EVAL application = MV_APPEND("(all applications)", apps)
| MV_EXPAND application
| EVAL ord = CASE(application == "(all applications)", 0, 1)
| SORT ord ASC, application ASC
| KEEP application
config.title: Application
